summary: Iteration 6 end-to-end verification of the account-verification workflow + school-isolation feature. Backend pytest (/app/backend/tests/test_iter6_verification.py) 14/14 passed. Frontend Playwright covered every listed UI flow. All acceptance criteria satisfied.
critical_code_review_comments: security.require_roles correctly gates non-admin users when status != 'approved' with 403 'Akun Anda menunggu verifikasi admin' — verified for /student/dashboard and /proctor/*.

routes_auth.register + register/proctor both hash password, force lowercase email, set status='pending' and immediately issue session cookies so the user is redirected to /pending client-side. Confirmed by test.
routes_admin.update_user validates status ∈ {pending,approved,rejected} — returns 400 for invalid values (test_invalid_status_rejected).
routes_admin.list_users joins schools -> u.school_name, and preserves u.school_name_text for pending proctors so UI can render '<name> (belum ditautkan)'.
routes_proctor._school_students correctly returns [] when school_id is None — approved proctor without linked school gets empty students & trainings (test_approved_proctor_no_school_returns_empty).
routes_proctor.trainings groups enrollments by course_id and populates student names from the proctor's own school only — proper isolation.
server.py startup migration sets status='approved' for legacy users lacking the field — confirmed via demo accounts regression (admin/student/proctor/tutor all return status='approved').
ProtectedRoute.jsx short-circuits when user.role !== 'admin' AND status != 'approved' -> Navigate to /pending — matches spec.

PendingVerification useEffect: if user is approved it redirects to roleHome, else if admin -> /admin. 'Periksa Status' button calls checkAuth() which re-fetches /auth/me — verified button visible & functional.

Register.js does client-side validation for school_id and shows 'Pilih asal sekolah terlebih dahulu' toast — but the underlying <Input required> attributes still allow bypass since Select isn't a native required control. The explicit check covers this well.

Minor: routes_auth.google_session marks NEW Google users pending (correct) but silently returns 200 with cookies set — client depends on status field to route. Would be safer to also refuse cookies for rejected accounts (not blocker, since portal endpoints already 403).
Minor: routes_admin.delete_user has no confirmation of role -> admin could accidentally delete other admins. Not an iter6 requirement, but worth flagging.
Minor: routes_auth.login does not surface status in a special field — client relies on /auth/me returning status. This works but a redundant field on login response would simplify frontend flow.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 verification workflow (student/proctor registration -> pending, admin approve/reject/link-school, proctor isolation, proctor /trainings) is fully functional. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_verification.py (loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env). Full regression suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/ (iter1 + iter2 + iter3 + iter6). Data-testids for UI: register-name/grade/phone/school/email/password/goal/submit, proctor-school-name/name/email/phone/password/submit, pending-verification/pending-refresh/pending-logout, tab-pending, approve-user-<id>/reject-user-<id>/edit-user-<id>, edit-user-dialog/edit-role/edit-school/edit-status/save-edit-user, proctor-trainings/training-<courseId>.
rca of the issue: No product bugs found. During UI testing the first run's proctor edit failed because 'text=Proktor' matched multiple elements (badge + tab); rewrote to stay on the Menunggu tab and locate the row directly — succeeded, and confirmed 'SMA UI TEST2 (belum ditautkan)' rendering, dialog fields (role/school/status), successful PUT, and post-approval proctor sees exactly SMA Nusantara 1's students (3 course cards + 4/1/1 participants) — no siswa from SMA Harapan Bangsa leaked in.
